sealedValue.description: The encrypted part of a record on an encrypted drive: everything the PDS doesn't need to see, as a JSON object, sealed with AES-256-GCM under the drive key's record-sealing subkey (HKDF-SHA256, info 'atdrive record sealing v1'). The associated data is 'atdrive record v2', the space's URI, the collection and the record key, each ended by a zero byte, so it can't be moved to another record or another drive.

keyID.description: Which drive key sealed it: 8 bytes derived from the key, as hex.

sealed.description: A random 12-byte nonce, the ciphertext, then the 16-byte tag.

wrappedKeyring.description: The drive's keyring wrapped for one device's public key: HPKE (RFC 9180) in auth mode, with DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256 and AES-256-GCM. The info is 'atdrive keyring v2', a zero byte, the space's URI, a zero byte. Auth mode proves which device wrapped it.

sender.description: The raw public key of the device that wrapped it.

encapsulatedKey.description: HPKE's enc: the ephemeral public key.

ciphertext.description: The keyring's keys, oldest first, 32 bytes each, then the 16-byte tag.

recoveryWrappedKeyring.description: The drive's keyring wrapped with the recovery key: AES-256-GCM under a key derived from it (HKDF-SHA256, info 'atdrive recovery wrap v1'), with the same associated data as a wrapped keyring's info.

sealed.description: A random 12-byte nonce, the ciphertext, then the 16-byte tag.
